item.title: How Large Language Models (LLMs) Learn: Calculus and the Search for Understanding
item.description: When you interact with a large language model (LLM) such as ChatGPT or Claude , the model seems to respond instantly relative to the question’s degree of difficulty. What’s easy to forget is that every word it predicts comes from a long history of learning where billions of gradient steps have slowly sculpted its understanding of language.
